name: application-coverage-comparison-card
title: Coverage Comparison Card
description: Side-by-side insurance plan cards with deductible/premium/coverage-max rows and an optional 'Best value' highlight, with all figures computed from real plan data.
useWhen: Comparing a small number (2-4) of insurance or coverage plans side by side as standalone cards rather than a dense table.
Each plan's deductible, premium, and coverage maximum are the primary numbers a shopper needs to compare.
One plan should be visually recommended as the best value without hiding the others' numbers.
avoidWhen: You're comparing generic SaaS/software feature sets with boolean included/excluded rows — use `feature-comparison-matrix` for that dense table layout instead.
You have more than 4 plans — a card grid this wide should become a scrollable table instead.
Deductible/premium/coverage aren't the relevant axes — reach for a plain pricing card instead.
responsiveBehavior: Single column on narrow screens, 3-column grid at sm breakpoint and above; the highlighted plan's badge stays centered above its card at all widths.
accessibility: Plan cards are grouped under a single role="group" with an aria-label describing the choice being made.
The 'Best value' recommendation is conveyed by a text badge and border color together, never by color alone.
All monetary figures are formatted with Intl.NumberFormat and rendered as real text, remaining fully readable to screen readers.

variants.title: Coverage Comparison Card
variants.description: Basic/Standard/Premium plans with Standard highlighted as Best value, deductible decreasing and coverage max increasing across tiers.
accessibility: All plan figures are formatted from real numeric props via Intl.NumberFormat rather than hardcoded strings.

variants.title: Coverage Comparison Card (Dark)
variants.description: Coverage comparison card adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Highlight border and badge colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
